interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan or run a browser automation task with Browser Use. Choose the appropriate local library, CLI, or hosted API, and prioritize evidence-based execution and safe handling of side effects.
interface.longDescription: Guides browser-use setup and safe, evidence-based browser automation for interactive websites, QA testing, structured extraction, and repetitive web workflows. This package provides workflow guidance and does not itself install or host the browser-use runtime.

name: browser-use-automation
description: Practical workflows for using the open-source Browser Use agent to automate browser interactions, web QA, scraping, and task execution.
